description: Non-live backtest of an intraday cumulative cap curve layered on a weekly-rollover funding model. Analytics ONLY; never loaded into the live StrategyConfig or any live/manual execution path. Live streams keep using config/sizing_ladder.json (the $3-base 0x-to-5x ladder) and the standing safeguards. See docs/backtest_curve.md.

model.base_amount_note: Backtest base is $1, distinct from the live $3.00 base. Live base amount policy is unchanged.
model.rollover_rule: current_week_available = 300 + prior_week_unused; unused weekly cash rolls forward
model.rollover_example: a week with $360 available that spends $210 leaves the next week starting at $450
model.daily_cap_rule: remaining_weekly_cash / remaining_trading_days_in_week, then the intraday cumulative cap curve applies to that daily cap
model.historical_prices: unchanged from the prior 60 trading day test

curve_definition: A / B / C are cumulative percentages of the calculated daily cap deployable by 10:30, 12:30, and 3:20 respectively; C is always 100
review_note: Monthly review should include this weekly-rollover intraday cap curve analysis and re-evaluate the highlighted 35 / 65 / 100 candidate.
historical_note: Backtest-only. Never loaded into the live StrategyConfig. The active execution ladder remains config/sizing_ladder.json.
